_real_world.variant_scope: Type 055, Type 052D/052DL (VDS reported), Type 054A (late-production hulls only per OOB), Type 054B (towed array reported).
public_equipment: variable-depth sonar (VDS) / towed-array housing, stern-mounted (fit varies by class and production batch; no model designation public for any hull)

_provenance.modeling_note: The OOB notes a stern VDS/towed-array fitting for Type 055 (B-tier), a VDS reported for Type 052D (B-tier), a towed array fitted only on late-production Type 054A hulls (B-tier, not the full class), and a towed array reported for Type 054B (B-tier); no PLAN source gives a designation, detection range, or sensitivity figure for any of these fits. Modeled as a generic passive towed-array/VDS sonar following the repo's convention for a stern-deployed passive array (longer range and lower self-noise than the bow hull sonar, no active-ping capability modeled since none is reported for any of these fits).

sonar.mode.note: Passive: no active-ping capability is reported for any of these VDS/towed-array fits; modeled as passive-only, distinct from the bow hull sonar module's active/passive mode

sonar.max_range_m.note: no public detection-range figure for any hull's VDS/towed array; engineering estimate above the bow hull sonar module reflecting a towed array's lower self-noise and deeper deployment

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate typical of a towed-array processing cycle, longer than the bow sonar's active-ping period

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the bow hull sonar module, consistent with a lower-self-noise towed array

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate longer than the bow hull sonar module, consistent with slower towed-array bearing updates

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the bow hull sonar module

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with a passive array's coarser ranging (via triangulation/motion analysis, not direct ranging)

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate higher than the bow hull sonar module, consistent with a long linear towed-array's directivity advantage

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate lower than the bow hull sonar module, reflecting the towed array's isolation from ownship machinery/flow noise

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: standard engine ambient-ocean-noise scaffold constant, matched to the packet's bow hull sonar module

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array has no active source level

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: 0.0: not applicable to a passive-only array

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the packet's bow hull sonar module (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly lower than the bow hull sonar module, reflecting a variable-depth array's ability to work below the thermal layer

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m, above the bow hull sonar module

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: 0.0: a towed array deployed well astern of the ship's wake has a much smaller or negligible baffle-exclusion cone compared to a bow-mounted array

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; engineering estimate higher than the bow hull sonar module, reflecting a towed array's reduced sensitivity to ownship speed/flow noise

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: 0.0: no active-ping capability modeled for this passive-only towed-array/VDS fit

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, matched to the packet's bow hull sonar module

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, slightly larger window than the bow hull sonar module reflecting slower passive-array confirmation

sonar.passive_only.note: true: no active-ping capability is reported for any of these VDS/towed-array fits

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: a towed array/VDS with sufficient aperture and processing can provide range estimates via target motion analysis, modeled here as a full passive sonar rather than bearing-only

modeling_notes: Shared across 4 classes per the OOB's fragmentary, per-class VDS/towed-array mentions; none carries enough distinguishing performance data to justify separate records. Type 054A's fit is noted as late-production-hulls-only in _real_world, not modeled as a separate per-hull-batch variant.
